title: Strict henselization is ind-etale over an affine chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, s:Spec Ω→S an algebraically closed geometric point, i:Spec R→S an affine open immersion containing the image of the closed point of s, A a commutative ring, e:Spec A≅S_(s), and a:R→A a ring map whose spectrum composed with i equals e followed by the strict henselization structural map. Equip A with the algebra structure induced by a. Then A is ind-etale over R.

proof.text: Factor s through the affine chart using the singleton spectrum of Ω. Apply etale_local_ring_triples to obtain cofiltered affine neighbourhoods, their initial chart subcategory, the equivalence E with etale residue triples, and the compatible ring-colimit comparison t.

The incoming-arrow clause of the same theorem transfers cofilteredness to the chart subcategory. Its opposite is filtered, so E transfers filteredness to triples. Choose one triple t₀ and set rho = t₀.alpha followed by its colimit leg. For any arrow, R-linearity and cocone naturality identify the two resulting R-maps. A common successor shows every triple has the same resulting map rho.

Identify strictHenselizationRing with the affine-neighbourhood colimit using colimit.isoColimitCocone, and then with the triple colimit by t. Use the pointed affine chart itself as a neighbourhood, with identity chart factorization. The diagram and coprojection compatibility equations identify rho transported back to the strict-henselization ring with this chart coprojection. The strict-localization cone structural-map identity then identifies its spectrum composed with i with strictHenselizationStructuralMap.

Shrink the chart category to a small model, using essential smallness of affine pointed neighbourhoods and full subcategories. Whisker the triple colimit along its equivalence with this model. Full faithfulness of Spec turns e into a ring isomorphism to A; extend the colimit along it. Cancel the mono i and use faithfulness of Spec on ha to identify the transported R-map with a. The triple structural maps form a natural transformation from the constant R diagram, are etale by HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff, and compose with all colimit legs to a. Apply RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04HX proof; Tag 04GW filtered etale presentation. C4 reconstructs and simplifies the previous G2 comparison proof for the available strict-localization API: filteredness is transferred from the chart category and the chart itself identifies the structural map.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (i : Spec R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hs : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ Set.range i)
    (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (a : R →+* A)
    (ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) ≫ i =
      e.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) :
    letI : Algebra R A := a.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IndEtale R A
